RxJava 4.x reactive library codebase (~945 main Java files). Uses Gradle, Java 21, requires `--enable-preview` for unnamed variables (`_`). Unbuildable without deps (Gradle + network), but individual files compile via `javac --enable-preview --release 21`.

**Why:** Full GitHub codebase refactoring subject; verify changes compile with stub javac.

**How to apply:** Target `src/main/java/io/reactivex/rxjava4/`; compile individual files with `javac --enable-preview --release 21 --source-path src/main/java -d /tmp/out <file>`. Pre-existing ClassWriter `@NonNull` annotation warnings are noise.

## Refactor #7 (2026-10-23)

Method-reference simplification in `ObjectHelper.java`:
- `BiObjectPredicate` was a 7-line boilerplate `static final class` whose only purpose was to delegate `test(o1, o2)` to `Objects.equals`.
- Replaced `new BiObjectPredicate()` with `Objects::equals` directly on the `EQUALS` field, deleting the class.

`BiPredicate` is `@FunctionalInterface`, so the method reference is valid. 7 lines deleted.

## Refactor #6 (2026-10-23)

Extract-method deduplication in `InstantPeriodicTask.java`:
- `setFirst(Future<?> f)` and `setRest(Future<?> f)` were identical CAS spin-loops differing only in which `AtomicReference<Future<?>>` they operated on.
- Extracted `private setFuture(AtomicReference<Future<?>> ref, Future<?> f)`; both public methods now delegate to it.

19 lines → 12 lines. Compiles clean.

## Refactor #5 (2026-10-23)

Dead-code removal + simplification in `RxThreadFactory.java`:
- Deleted 18-line commented-out `CREATE_TRACE` debug-trace feature (field declaration + conditional stack-trace StringBuilder block).
- Collapsed `StringBuilder nameBuilder = new StringBuilder(prefix).append('-').append(incrementAndGet()); String name = nameBuilder.toString();` into `String name = prefix + "-" + incrementAndGet();`.

25 lines → 1 line. Compiles clean.

## Refactor #1 (2026-10-23)

Convert 4 `static final class` types in `Functions.java` to `record`:
- `Array5Func` — was the only `static final class` in the `Array2Func`–`Array9Func` series; all others were already records.
- `ToMapKeySelector`, `ToMapKeyValueSelector`, `ToMultimapKeyValueSelector` — package-private adapters wrapping function fields; all other equivalent adapters in the file used records.

Constructor argument order and factory method call sites unchanged. Compiles clean.

## Refactor #4 (2026-10-23)

Three files, 7 conversions:
- `SingleInternalHelper`: `ToFlowableIterator` + `ToFlowableIterable` → records; dropped redundant `remove()` override (`Iterator.remove()` default already throws `UnsupportedOperationException`).
- `ObservableReplay`: `DisposeConsumer<R>` (1 field) + `ScheduledReplaySupplier<T>` (5 fields) → records; `ReplayBufferSupplier` was already a record.
- `FlowableReplay`: `ScheduledReplayBufferSupplier<T>` (5 fields) → record; `ReplayBufferSupplier` was already a record.

All compile clean. 54 lines removed.

## Refactor #3 (2026-10-23)

Convert 4 `static final class` types in `FlowableInternalHelper.java` to `record`:
- `FlatMapWithCombinerInner`, `FlatMapWithCombinerOuter`, `FlatMapIntoIterable`, `TimedReplay` — Flowable counterpart of the same fix applied to `ObservableInternalHelper`.
- All other adapter/supplier types in the file were already records; `TimedReplay` had an extra non-`private final` field (`eagerTruncate`) which records handle implicitly.

Compiles clean.

Convert 4 `static final class` types in `ObservableInternalHelper.java` to `record`:
